notes.title: Steam Award Nominations 2019!
notes.content:
The Steam Autumn Sale has begun, and so has the 2019 Steam Award Nominations!

This year, the community is given the opportunity to choose the categories to nominate Degrees of Separation! While we highlighted the cooperative features of the game, Degrees of Separation can be nominated for any category you choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33668480/c4a28caf51e916cb7ea2d110ded7e5fb299aec81.png[/img]

What about Degrees of Separation speaks to you? The innovative cooperative gameplay? The romantic narrative of Rime and Ember working in tandem? The visual storytelling of two opposite worlds surviving together? Let us know by choosing your nomination category for this year's Steam Awards!

Thank you all in advance for any nominations we receive!

notes.title: Degrees of Separation online multiplayer is now available!
notes.content:
Degrees of Separation version 1.2 is now live. Content includes online functionality, general bug fixes and stability improvements.

Players will be able to take their existing save files online to play with friends, and progress earned through cooperative play will be kept by each user.

To begin an online multiplayer session, select multiplayer from the main menu and invite players through the Steam overlay.

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 11
notes.content:
The game has been updated to fix issues regarding playing co-op on a keyboard or when playing with a controller+keyboard combo. An important note is that "player 1" and "player 2" use different keys on the keyboard regardless of what setup you use. They are as following:

[b]Player 1[/b]
[list]
[*] Move - WASD
[*] Jump - Space
[*] Use - E
[*] Call Companion - F
[/list]

[b]Player 2[/b]
[list]
[*] Move - Arrow keys
[*] Jump - L
[*] Use - K
[*] Call Companion - J
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668480/2c91814700aced62dbcfa85560b1a5cbc17b7a7b.png[/img]

When playing single player, the controls for Player 1 is used, with the addition of using Q to change character.

If the game does not update for you, you can restart Steam to force it.

[i]Update March 14[/i]
To be clear - you can now play the game coop using the following setups:
[list]
[*] both players on the same keyboard
[*] one player on the keyboard, one player using a controller
[*] both players using a controller each
[/list]

If you own a controller that does not work with the game, please let us know.

notes.title: Online Co-op
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Happy Valentine's Day! We are more than happy that the DoS launch is finally here!

We know many of you are excited for our online co-op feature, and so are we! We’re working on a patch right now that will allow you to play with your friends online. We’ll keep you updated on our progress! Thanks for your patience everyone!
